work.name: Aberdeen Software Factory
highlights: Implemented and deployed a full-stack web application to display archaeological artefacts using the RTI library, enabling users to interactively view objects under varying lighting conditions (live demo: sbx-rti-1.abdn.ac.uk)
Developed a custom REST API to upload, store, and retrieve artefact data and images efficiently, with pagination supporting thousands of entries
Utilised Vue, Docker, Python, JavaScript to build the application from scratch
Selected for funding by British Academy's Talent Development Award

work.name: Science and Technology Facilities Council (STFC)
highlights: Implemented over 60 features and bug fixes across backend and frontend components of experiment control system deployed on ISIS Neutron and Muon Source using Java, Python, C, Git, EPICS
Chaired weekly Agile/Scrum meetings for planning and review across sprints
Refactored a key internal script into a modern Python package, accelerating equipment integration and improving reliability
Implemented unit and end-to-end tests for the Java desktop application
Configured continuous integration and delivery pipelines in Jenkins
Collaborated with over 10 scientists and PhD students running physics experiments; diagnosed and resolved any issues reported

work.name: University of Aberdeen
highlights: Provided clear explanations and guided problem-solving in C and Assembly, improving student comprehension and engagement
Collected feedback from hundreds of students to drive actionable improvements in Student-Staff Liaison Committee meetings

awards.title: Best Computing Student of the year

projects.name: Machine Learning Web Visualisation

projects.name: Indoor Navigation Web App

Engineered Al-based pathfinding system with a NoSQL database, enabling fast and efficient indoor routing
Secured £2,000 in funding and dedicated office space from the University of Aberdeen and ABVentures incubator
Grew user adoption to over 80 weekly users by transforming a university project into a functional, widely used solution
Led a four-member team through full app lifecycle, from ideation to deployment, applying iterative development practices
